patch.value: Report criterion bindings that lose current source support

Overlap audit: core SDK owns criterion splitting, certified item reads, history and conditional mutations. pm-lint validates declared witnesses; pm-context packs criterion evidence. This package supplies exact source-resolution and freshness facts through an adapter; it does not reproduce witness validation or packing.

Editing one cited fragment invalidates only its bound criteria; A criterion edit invalidates its old bindings; Resolving a citation never labels it proof of truth; Typed SDK and agent-sized TOON/JSON CLI expose facts with actionable refusals; Real public-tracker copy and seeded SDK state-readback tests validate the contract without git

value.text: Re-review blocking finding accepted. General rule: wall-clock timestamps are not revisions, so stale-state writes must fence all state they derive from with an SDK lock-held precondition. Repeated updated_at values can make timestamp-only CAS erase a persisted peer review. Auditing every SDK/CLI mutation, read-only fact freshness check and transaction identity in the package; will use a fixed-clock non-git adversarial test across all producers and failure-on-revert proof. Worktree is clean and origin/main has no commits missing from this branch. No additional inline or review findings are currently posted on the PR; the supplied orchestrator finding is authoritative.
